items.title: Praise be to Allah who gave us life
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahi lladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa'ilayhin-nushoor
items.translation: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the rising.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6312: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9463

items.title: I have submitted myself to You
items.cue: The last words before sleep, lying on the right side
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَهْبَةً وَرَغْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wa'alja'tu zahree ilayk, rahbatan waraghbatan ilayk, laa malja'a walaa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bikitaabika lladhee anzalt, wabinabiyyika lladhee arsalt
items.translation: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affair to You, and turned my back to You for support, in fear and in hope of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down, and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6311: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9461

provenance.note: We follow the printed al-Sultaniyya text of hadith 6311 on Shamela (أسلمت نفسي … رهبة ورغبة). Under the same number hadith-api gives أسلمت وجهي … رغبة ورهبة, the wording of another narration of this hadith.

usage.evidence: Make your ablution as for prayer, lie on your right side and say this; if you die, you die upon the natural way, so make these the last words you say. When al-Bara' repeated it back with "Your Messenger", the Prophet ﷺ said: no, "Your Prophet whom You sent" (al-Bukhari 6311).

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi
items.cue: The Verse of the Throne, read on going to bed

usage.evidence: In the story of Abu Hurayrah guarding the zakat of Ramadan, he was told that whoever reads Ayat al-Kursi on going to bed has a guardian from Allah until morning, and the Prophet ﷺ said: he told you the truth, though he is a liar (al-Bukhari 2311, given by al-Bukhari without a full chain of his own).

items.title: The last two ayahs of al-Baqarah
items.cue: The two ayahs that suffice whoever reads them at night

usage.evidence: Whoever recites the two ayahs at the end of Surat al-Baqarah in a night, they suffice him (al-Bukhari 5009; Muslim 808).

items.title: In Your name I die and live
items.cue: The short words on going to bed
items.translation: In Your name I die and live.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6312: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9463

items.title: In Your name, my Lord, I lie down
items.cue: What to say after shaking out the bed
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbee wabika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa'in arsaltahaa fahfaz'haa bimaa tahfazu bihis-saaliheen
items.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You keep my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, guard it with what You guard the righteous with.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6320: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9477

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela ends تحفظ به الصالحين; hadith-api has عبادك الصالحين. We follow the printed edition.

usage.evidence: When one of you goes to bed, let him shake out his bed with the inside of his wrapper, for he does not know what has come onto it after him, then say this (al-Bukhari 6320).

items.title: Al-Falaq
items.cue: The second of the three surahs at bedtime

usage.evidence: Aishah reports that each night, on going to bed, the Prophet ﷺ cupped his hands, blew into them and recited these three surahs, then wiped as much of his body as he could, three times (al-Bukhari 5017).

items.title: Al-Ikhlas
items.cue: The first of the three surahs blown into the hands at bedtime

usage.evidence: Aishah reports that each night, on going to bed, the Prophet ﷺ cupped his hands, blew into them and recited these three surahs, then wiped as much of his body as he could, three times (al-Bukhari 5017).

items.title: An-Nas
items.cue: The third of the three surahs at bedtime

usage.evidence: Aishah reports that each night, on going to bed, the Prophet ﷺ cupped his hands, blew into them and recited these three surahs, then wiped as much of his body as he could, three times (al-Bukhari 5017).
